decision: Chose eu-west-1 because ADR 0001 requires customer lists to live in EU regions only, and these jobs carry the customer list. Recorded Mira's no-customer-names-in-logs rule as a new ADR that applies to every product, with a pointer in this repo's AGENTS.md. Nothing is committed.

recorded.info: New accepted ADR (key no-customer-names-in-logs): Mira's verbatim words that nothing we build may ever write a customer's name into a log, for every repo and product.
Added a pointer to ADR 0001 (EU regions only, use eu-west-1) and ADR 0005 (no customer names in logs).
